finding: The raw archive contains authentication/recovery/security messages and credential-like values intermingled with normal HR correspondence. Exact secret values are intentionally not recorded in this knowledge record.
sensitive_classes_observed: employee/applicant PII and restricted case data
payroll/tax/benefit identifiers in source mail or attachments
calendar/ICS meeting join links and meeting passcodes
embedded conferencing/reschedule URLs with access parameters
controls: Do not commit raw mailbox text to GitHub.
Do not embed or send the full raw archive to remote semantic-index providers by default.
Before semantic indexing, detect and redact/suppress passwords, OTPs, PINs, registration/access codes, recovery codes, tokens, SSNs, account numbers and similar secrets.
Treat security notifications as metadata/process evidence while excluding the secret payload.
Keep employee/applicant/case text in restricted local storage and retrieve only narrowly scoped snippets when authorized.
Maintain a local provenance link from sanitized derived claims to message IDs without copying sensitive text into canonical knowledge.
Use deterministic rules plus secret/PII scanners before any raw message becomes agent-visible.
Logs and debugging output must redact secrets as well.
Sanitize ICS/calendar attachments before indexing: retain organizer, subject, dates/status and business relationship when useful, but redact meeting passcodes and access-bearing join/reschedule URLs.
Treat attachment payloads as subject to the same secret/PII boundary as message bodies; extraction must pass sensitivity classification before semantic indexing.

retrieval_policy.raw_message_access: explicitly scoped local retrieval only when needed for the user's task
retrieval_policy.durable_memory: never store authentication secrets or employee/applicant case details
